project.purpose: Bind exact security subjects to provider-native evidence, freshness/applicability, policy decisions, and standing projections while external tools own scanning/vulnerability/policy mechanics.

nodes.label: SubjectIdentity
nodes.responsibility: Bind the exact code/package/system subject under security evaluation.
acceptance: Evidence cannot silently drift to another subject.

nodes.label: ProviderEvidence
nodes.responsibility: Retain provider-native SARIF/SBOM/OSV/decision outputs through digest-bound EvidenceRef records.

nodes.label: Applicability
nodes.responsibility: Bind freshness/applicability/admission context supplied by owner/provider.
acceptance: The Security owner verification refuses a stale uv.lock before consuming locked dependencies.

nodes.label: PolicyDecision
nodes.responsibility: Compose bounded policy input and external OPA/Rego decision without cloning the policy engine.
acceptance: Policy effect is traceable to exact evidence/context.

nodes.label: StandingProjection
nodes.responsibility: Project current security standing without claiming that tool installation/selection equals admission.
acceptance: Selected providers remain distinct from admitted/accepted coverage.

slices.objective: Admit additional selected P0 providers only from a concrete consumer/security gap, keeping selection distinct from production admission.
acceptance: The next provider addition names a consumer need, exact evidence contract, admission boundary, and independent acceptance; otherwise it remains selected-only.
slices.nextAction: Use current Scorecard selected/accepted-but-not-admitted standing as the first policy pressure test.

slices.objective: Bind transitive authority and compositional security claims to exact principals, service effects, configuration versions, and independent consumer tests.
acceptance: For each tested effect path, principal -> Tool -> service -> external resource authority is enumerated and bounded.
Substitution/composition of two locally valid LEGO nodes does not widen effective READ/WRITE/NETWORK/PERSIST/EFFECT sets.
Existing AS01-AS12/XAS13-XAS18 security lens is reused; no second policy engine or cross-owner authority registry is created.
slices.nextAction: Qualify one high-risk MCP/Runtime/network consumer path with existing Security owner policy and evidence projection.

gaps: Selected P0/P1 providers are not automatically active/admitted capabilities.

review.notes: Initial project-native LEGO planning projection. It does not replace owner-native architecture or evidence.
